questions.question: When it is 14:00 in Johannesburg, what time is it in Beijing, 6 hours ahead, and in São Paulo, 5 hours behind?
questions.expected_answer: Beijing is ahead, so add 6 hours to get 20:00. São Paulo is behind, so subtract 5 hours to get 09:00.

questions.question: A flight leaves Johannesburg at 10:30 and takes 8 hours. What is the local time in Dubai, 2 hours ahead, when it lands?
questions.expected_answer: In South African time it lands at 18:30. Dubai is 2 hours ahead, so the local time there is 20:30.

questions.question: When it is 20:00 in Johannesburg, what is the time and day in Tokyo, 7 hours ahead?
questions.expected_answer: Adding 7 hours passes midnight: 4 hours take you to midnight and 3 more hours take you to 03:00. So it is 03:00 the next day in Tokyo.
